profile_text.body:
Google is a public company founded in 1998, headquartered in Mountain View, CA, USA, and traded as GOOGL. Its most recent 10-K, for the period ending 2025-12-31, reported revenue of $402,836,000,000. Its Gemini site describes Gemini as Google's AI assistant, offering help with writing, planning, and brainstorming.

The company's tracked AI products span several areas. Gemini is listed as a general LLM assistant, Google AI Studio for model prototyping, and NotebookLM for document grounding over uploaded material. Google Med-PaLM / MedLM is listed as a medical LLM covering clinical reasoning and healthcare data, with a HIPAA BAA required and diagnostic liability noted. TensorFlow / Keras is listed as an ML framework with model serialization risks and TensorFlow Extended (TFX) for MLOps. Workspace products include Google Drive AI and Google Meet AI. A set of education products is tracked, among them Gemini for Education, Google Meet notes (Take notes for me), Google Teachable Machine, Google NotebookLM, Google Calendar, Google Docs version history, Google Forms, Google Read Along, Google Sheets, Google Sites, Google Slides, Google Slides captions, and Google Translate. Pricing noted for these includes Google AI Pro for Education at $15 per user per month promotional and $20 list with an annual commitment, and free inclusion in Workspace for Education editions for several products.

Third-party MCP servers listed under the Google name cover Google Ads reporting and campaign management, Google Ads campaign, keyword, and metric management, reading and managing a Google Ads account in chat, news search, Search Console rankings and indexing, Google OAuth credential and LangChain agents, Google Sign-In agents for Claude and LangChain, Google Forms, Google Calendar, and Google Trends. A case, Buist v. Anthropic, PBC, is recorded in the District Court, N.D. California. California is listed with a case count of 281.
